sections.title: Tuesday:

regional.headline: A cloudy and wet night, breezy.

sections.title: This Evening and Tonight:
sections.text: Rain quickly spreading north-eastwards this evening and becoming persistent for a time overnight across much of the region. The rain will be heavy at times and accompanied by a strengthening breeze, particularly along the south coast.

sections.title: Tuesday:
sections.text: Cloudy with overnight rain clearing just after dawn. Blustery, and at times heavy, showers follow with a risk of hail and thunder. Milder but tempered by the fresh winds.

sections.title: Outlook for Wednesday to Friday:
sections.text: Changeable on Wednesday and Thursday with scattered heavy showers and some bright or sunny intervals. Showers clearing later on Friday. Temperatures near normal for the time of year.

sections.title: This Evening and Tonight:
sections.text: It will become breezy as a band of rain arrives from the southwest this evening. The rain will become heavy at times during the early hours, with some sleet for a time over the Peak District. Feeling cold.

sections.title: Tuesday:
sections.text: A damp start on Tuesday with outbreaks of rain through the morning, sometimes heavy, turning drier later. A milder day than yesterday, but breezy.

sections.title: Outlook for Wednesday to Friday:
sections.text: A changeable few days ahead, remaining chilly with blustery showers on Wednesday. Further outbreaks of rain on Thursday, before winds ease and brighter skies return on Friday.
